chunks.title: CLO 2024.2 - Print Emission - Discharge
chunks.content: ## Basic Settings Optimization in CLO 2024.2 Print Emission - Discharge This section explains the optimized basic settings for print emission and discharge in CLO 2024.2, focusing on fabric dimension settings, garment count, spacing, and layout controls. In this version, functions related to basic settings have been optimized. Users can add accurate sewing information, then switch to print and release mode. By clicking on the fabric in the object window, you can set the fabric’s width in the property editor. Similarly, fabric width can be modified in the material settings. The length of the fabric can be manually set to calculate the version based on length. Units can also be adjusted, including setting the material direction to double. The fabric length can be changed to meet specific requirements. Users can set the number of garments, choosing between one and four for material calculation. Spacing between fabrics in designated areas can also be configured. Additionally, the number of garments requiring sleeves can be specified. When generating 3D clothing, the system calculates the machine horse unit number and estimates material costs using a single-row method. The current garment size can be entered directly in the scene. After entering the necessary keys, the layout setting is completed by clicking the plate layout button to start the layout process. When the progress bar nears 100% and the layout image stabilizes, users can stop the layout calculation. --- ## Layout Completion and Fabric Information Display This section details how fabric layout results are displayed, including fabric names, grainline direction, plate counts, and material dimensions. Upon completing the layout, the fabric name appears at the top of the layout area along with the grainline direction and the number of plates placed. The file name is displayed on the left side, showing the length and volume of the material. On the right side, the fabric width and volume are shown, along with the number of keys. This information is also available in the property editor for convenient reference. Previously, different fabrics had to be arranged separately. In this version, switching between different fabrics shows that all fabrics have been arranged together. To rearrange, users can reset arrangement settings, remove excess fabric sheets, and perform fabric operations again. The "Reset to Default Arrangement" option allows users to closely arrange scattered sheets within the fabric area, displaying them at the top position. --- ## Mixed Fabric Calculation and Size Key Management in Print and Release Mode This section covers calculating mixed fabrics for 3D riding suits, setting size keys for garments, and managing lining colors. When the 3D riding suit is completed, the number of mixed fabrics can be calculated in print and release mode. In the property editor under the single machine settings, users select the riding button located to the right of the garment count. The number of each size key required for lining can be entered. The total number of garments is displayed at the top.
chunks.content_description: CLO 2024.2 Print Emission and Material Layout New Upgrade! By applying material layout to grouped marker sizes and color-matching schemes, fabric consumption can be calculated more accurately, while also simplifying the material layout process for color-matched styles.

chunks.title: CLO 2024.2 - Print Emission - Discharge
chunks.content: --- ## Mixed Fabric Calculation and Size Key Management in Print and Release Mode This section covers calculating mixed fabrics for 3D riding suits, setting size keys for garments, and managing lining colors. When the 3D riding suit is completed, the number of mixed fabrics can be calculated in print and release mode. In the property editor under the single machine settings, users select the riding button located to the right of the garment count. The number of each size key required for lining can be entered. The total number of garments is displayed at the top. Users can modify all size key numbers quickly by entering values. If size keys need to be set proportionally, such as adjusting S and XL sizes as one key, this is supported. Users can also divide garments according to size, a new function added in this version. Next, lining colors are selected. Users can choose to line only the current color or select multiple colors as needed. By clicking the color button on the right side, color information is selected for lining. Selected colors are lined together. After lining is complete, opening the display to apply codes in random colors shows a clear visual division of size versions based on the horse size. Closing the display removes the random colors. When switching horses, the current horse version’s position is highlighted. Changing the flag color shows that all garments with the selected flag color are lined together. --- ## Pattern Display and File Saving This section explains how to display patterns and save files after setting pattern sizes and display information. To display a pattern, users can click the quick photo option. After setting the pattern size and required display information, clicking save stores the file to the machine. --- ## Summary CLO 2024.2 introduces optimized functions for print emission and discharge, including precise fabric dimension settings, garment and sleeve count management, improved layout handling across multiple fabrics, mixed fabric calculations for 3D clothing, enhanced size key and lining color management, as well as pattern display and file saving capabilities. These updates make print and release operations more flexible and efficient.
